verdict.first_step_1: Feed two separate jars side-by-side (one with new flour, one with old flour or rye) and track their peak rise hourly over 4 to 8 hours.
verdict.first_step_2: Feed a single jar at a 1:2:2 ratio, mark it with a rubber band, and check if it doubles within 4 to 8 hours to isolate whether the starter or dough failed.
verdict.reason: Reply 2 correctly tests whether the starter doubles in a marked jar and allows multiple feeding cycles for adaptation, avoiding Reply 1's flawed single-cycle two-jar test.
